description: Paramount+ offers content from CBS, MTV, Nickelodeon, and Paramount Pictures for $5.99-11.99/month. Users seek cheaper or free alternatives.

alternatives.name: Tubi
alternatives.reason: Completely free with 40,000+ movies and TV shows

alternatives.name: Plex
alternatives.reason: Free ad-supported movies/TV plus personal media server

alternatives.name: Peacock
alternatives.reason: More affordable alternative with NBC/Universal content

steps: Browse free alternatives (Tubi, Plex, Peacock Free)
Check JustWatch.com for Paramount+ shows on other platforms
Consider antenna TV for local channels
tips: Peacock Free has a surprising amount of free content
Paramount+ shows often move to Netflix after exclusivity period

verdict: Tubi and Plex offer free streaming. Peacock Free is a good no-cost alternative with NBC content.

faqs.question: Is Paramount+ worth it for Star Trek?
faqs.answer: If you only want Star Trek, consider buying episodes on iTunes or Amazon Prime Video instead of a monthly subscription.

faqs.question: Can I watch Paramount+ for free?
faqs.answer: Paramount+ offers a limited free tier. Also check Tubi and Plex for Paramount movies/TV.

faqs.answer: Yes, Peacock has a free tier with limited content. It includes some NBC shows, movies, and live channels.

faqs.question: Can I watch NBC shows for free?

description: Max (formerly HBO Max) offers HBO, Warner Bros., DC, and Discovery content at $9.99-20.99/month. Users seek alternatives for lower cost.

alternatives.name: Tubi
alternatives.reason: Completely free with 40,000+ movies and TV shows

alternatives.name: Plex
alternatives.reason: Free ad-supported movies/TV plus personal media server

alternatives.name: Disney+
alternatives.reason: More affordable alternative with Disney/Marvel content

steps: Check JustWatch.com for Max shows on other platforms
Consider antenna TV for local channels
tips: Max shows often move to other platforms after exclusivity
Library cards often include free streaming (Kanopy, Hoopla)

verdict: Tubi and Plex offer free streaming. Netflix has a larger catalog for similar pricing.

faqs.question: Is Max worth it for HBO shows?
faqs.answer: If you only want HBO shows, consider buying episodes on iTunes or Amazon Prime Video instead of a monthly subscription.

faqs.question: Can I watch Max for free?
faqs.answer: Max does not have a free tier. Check Tubi, Plex, or your library card (Kanopy) for Max content.
